g.text: Astral Project — Implemented Remote SFTP Session Path
require exact command and transport key
decode exact fields; verify grant signature,
host ID, host-key fingerprint, user, and time
reverify signed grant and server identity
require every export within the per-root ceiling
device, inode, mount ID, filesystem type, and kind
stream, log, sources, and runtime only
SFTP request through SSH and bridge
SFTP response through bridge and SSH
The rclone/aspr-transport producer of the local SFTP stream
belongs to the target architecture and is not yet integrated.
